sections.heading: What is Lead-to-Customer Rate?
paragraphs: Lead-to-Customer Rate (also called Lead Conversion Rate) measures the percentage of leads that convert into paying customers. It's one of the most critical B2B metrics, showing how effectively your sales funnel turns prospects into revenue. According to 2025 benchmark data, the average lead-to-customer conversion rate is 2-5% across B2B industries.

bullets.label: Sales Efficiency
bullets.text: Measures how well your sales team converts leads into revenue

bullets.label: Marketing ROI

bullets.label: CAC Impact
bullets.text: A 1-point lift (e.g., 2% → 3%) can cut Customer Acquisition Cost by 15-25%

bullets.label: Funnel Health
bullets.text: Identifies bottlenecks between marketing and sales handoffs

bullets.label: Revenue Forecasting
bullets.text: Essential for predicting pipeline and setting growth targets
